column1: # Slice 307 (CALL-WHOLE-ARGUMENTS-STRUCTURE), try a21 -- a20 with the lift walk moved into the registration round of lm_compiler_parse_unit,
# before each lm_compiler_collect_asgn_binds of the round (the probe p307h3 on a20, fe170m: the lift happened, but the hidden own did not
# exist when the owns were collected and the calls bound, so the binder read the actual positionally and refused "mytest has no argument a"
# at 104:13; a written `pack: merge(...)` is collected before the binding, and so is the hidden declaration now). The a20 fixes: the lift
# before the binding (lm_compiler_merge_lift_walk), the hidden name l2_lift_<method>_<offset>, the lifted own found by its name at the
# site (lm_compiler_own_at). Earlier fixes a13-a19 as in tp170-prepare-a20.tsv. The kernel, the driver and tools/build.lm2 unchanged
# since a13 (tool170d and rt170e stay). Run by `lmxtool steps` with the working tool of boot164a.
